settings.title: Voice dictation
settings.intro: Hold the shortcut, speak, let go: the text lands where you were.
settings.hotkeyHint: Click, then press your combo. Esc to cancel.
settings.unloadHint: After this long without dictation, the model frees the VRAM; the next one starts slower.
settings.liveHint: Text shows up while you talk (periodic re-transcription).

cpp.notInstalledHint: Needed for Nemotron. Not installable from the app yet: copy transcribe-cli into the NetsuRush bin folder.

mic.busy: Microphone is in use by another app.
mic.denied: Microphone access denied. Allow microphone access to dictate.
mic.fallback: Chosen microphone unavailable — using the default one.
